$comment: Copy this file to e.g. content/works/my-album.json (files starting with _ are ignored). Required: title, realm, description. realm is one of: digital, ventures, music, books, art. cover is a path relative to this folder (put the image in content/works/media/) or a data URI. Then run: npm run content
title: Title of the work
description: One or two sentences for the card.
portfolioDescription: The longer description shown on the work's own page.
